bbox_coordinate_system: PDF points; [left, top, right, bottom], origin at page top-left

images.method: Cropped the original embedded Im0 background photograph, converted from CMYK to RGB. The crop excludes catalog text and retains the complete product with its original background and shadow.
images.alt_zh: Super Drill 可轉位鑽頭，具有螺旋排屑槽與直柄夾持部位

dynamic_linework.method: Manually redrawn SVG linework, not a raster catalog-page image.
dynamic_linework.scale: Schematic, not to scale. Text labels come from the selected normalized holder record.
dimension_notes: SD L1 is rear shank length; T is catalog drilling depth.
The target hole diameter appears as a separate annotation and never overwrites nominal tool diameter D.
Missing dimensions appear as 未提供, never as zero or inferred length.
